channels.name: victory-gatehouse
channels.topic: Not one road and not one cave. A whole mountain you climb: a badge gate at the foot of it, then open cliff paths, rope bridges and a chain of caves that keep putting you back outside a little higher up. The League sits at the top, in sight for most of the way, which is the cruelty of the thing.  [UBER · 8 BADGES / FLASH]

channels.name: hinomiya-shrine
channels.topic: A fire shrine on the western rim of the caldera, reached by a stair nobody maintains and everybody uses. Kagura is danced here - the region is named for it - and the dancing is not for the crowd, because there is never a crowd.  [UBER · CLIMB]

channels.name: midori-jungle
channels.topic: The far side of the caldera, where the ash makes the soil absurdly rich and every cloud that clears the crater drops its rain. A pocket of proper jungle on an island that is otherwise grey.  [UU]

channels.name: kuroihama
channels.topic: Black sand on the north shore, ground down from old lava and hot enough by afternoon to cross at a run. The sea is the only cold thing here.  [RU]

channels.name: the-crater-pool
channels.topic: Rainwater caught in a vent above Ember Hollow, sitting on hot rock and steaming most mornings. A strange, bright green, and not water anyone drinks.  [UU · CLIMB]

channels.name: ashen-onsen
channels.topic: Volcanic water, wooden decking and a view of the sea over a field of black rock. The one place on Shiomi where the heat underfoot is a selling point.  [RU]

channels.name: storm-observatory
channels.topic: A weather station on the ridge above the strait, staffed by people who chose this. They track every front that crosses Kagura and will tell you, at length, what is coming.  [UU · CLIMB]

channels.name: the-ashfields
channels.topic: Everything the volcano has thrown downwind, gone soft over the years and grown over in patches. Grey underfoot, startlingly green wherever anything took root.  [RU]

channels.name: sulphur-barrens
channels.topic: Yellow ground, standing steam and water you would not drink. The north-east corner of Shiomi, which nobody farms and nobody settles, for reasons that announce themselves.  [UU]

channels.name: long-sands
channels.topic: The whole southern shore of Hinode in one unbroken run of pale sand, shallow enough to wade a long way out and empty enough that you will hear anyone else arriving.  [PU]

channels.name: the-mill-pond
channels.topic: Dammed to turn a wheel two centuries ago and kept because it turned out to be pleasant. Willows, a jetty, and the slowest water in Kagura.  [ZU]

channels.name: kagura-reservoir
channels.topic: What the station and the town drink. Fenced, signposted, and fished anyway by everyone who has ever lived nearby.  [PU]

channels.name: the-stables
channels.topic: Paddocks, a long barn and a yard that always smells of hay and leather. If you are travelling on something, this is where it gets shod, fed, swapped or bought.  [PU]

channels.name: the-day-care
channels.topic: An old couple, a walled garden and more patience than anyone reasonable has. Leave something with them and it comes back changed, usually for the better.  [ZU]

channels.name: hares-meadow
channels.topic: Open hay meadow south of the farms, cut once a year and left alone the rest of it. Waist-high by midsummer and full of things that would rather you did not notice them.  [ZU]

channels.name: the-windbreaks
channels.topic: Lines of old trees planted to stop the sea wind taking the topsoil, with sheltered strips of scrub between them. Everything on this coast lives in the lee of something.  [ZU]

channels.name: saltmarsh-flats
channels.topic: Where the southern rivers give up and spread out. Half land and half water depending on the hour, cut through with creeks that are deeper than they look.  [PU]

channels.name: shell-strand
channels.topic: Tsuki's southern beach, made mostly of what the reef throws up - shell, coral grit and bleached fragments, pale enough to be hard on the eyes at noon.  [UU]

channels.name: moon-pool
channels.topic: A lagoon behind the reef that the sea only reaches at the top of the tide, which leaves it glass-flat and lit from below whenever the sand is bright. Tsuki is named for nights like that.  [UU]

channels.name: trainers-hall
channels.topic: A tiered hall on the southern shore where people who have already won things come to keep winning them. Open ladder, no badges required, and a very long list of names on the wall.  [OU]

channels.name: driftwood-cove
channels.topic: A sheltered notch in the north coast where everything the strait loses eventually washes up. Half the cove is bleached timber and the other half is whatever came off the boats.  [UU]

channels.name: the-palmlands
channels.topic: The green middle of Tsuki: palm and broadleaf over soft ground, hot and loud and thick enough that the paths are the only sensible way through.  [UU]

channels.name: windward-dunes
channels.topic: The exposed eastern shore, where the dunes move a little every year and the sea arrives with nothing in its way. The last easy ground before the grotto.  [OU]

channels.name: the-reef
channels.topic: Warm water over a reef, and a drop-off at the edge of it that goes down further than the map bothers to say.  [UU-OU · DIVE]

channels.name: mirror-tarn
channels.topic: A high cold lake in a bowl of rock below the snowline, so still on a windless day that the mountain appears twice. Deep, far colder than it looks, and clear enough to see how far down that goes.  [RU]

channels.name: the-old-mine
channels.topic: Iron came out of this hill for two hundred years and then stopped. The head gear is still standing, the lower levels are flooded, and the upper galleries are somebody else's now.  [NU · FLASH]

channels.name: the-pinewood
channels.topic: Working forest on the eastern slope, planted in rows a long time ago and gone its own way since. Dark at ground level, quiet, and easy to lose your bearings in.  [NU]

channels.name: kogarashi-heath
channels.topic: Above the tree line and below the snow: heather, bare rock and wind with nothing to stop it. The ground between the woods and the mountain, and harder than either looks.  [RU]

channels.name: the-standing-stones
channels.topic: Nine stones in a ring on the heath, older than the castle and a good deal older than anyone's explanation of them. They are aligned on something, and nobody agrees on what - except the Psychic gym, dug into the hill beneath the ring, which seems to know.  [RU · PSYCHIC GYM]

channels.name: watari-bridge
channels.topic: The only way north on foot. A long timber span on stone piers, with a toll house at the southern end that has not collected a toll in years. Everyone crossing to the woods crosses here, and most of them come back.  [PU]

channels.name: kakehashi-bridge
channels.topic: A single enormous span across the eastern strait, high enough for ships and exposed enough that it closes in weather. Two miles of deck with nothing either side but wind and a long drop.  [UU]

channels.name: beacon-rock
channels.topic: A lighthouse on a rock, and the only Pokemon Centre that is not in a town - so Surf buys you a Fly anchor in the middle of the sea.  [- · SURF]

channels.name: sunken-bell
channels.topic: Whatever is under the shoal. Nothing on the surface marks it, which is the point of putting it on a map.  [UBER · DIVE]

channels.name: the-treeline
channels.topic: A forest that grew over something. The paths move, the light is wrong, and the gym is not a building - it is a clearing that keeps being found.  [NU · GHOST GYM]

channels.name: route-1
channels.topic: Coastal meadow, hedges, a plank bridge. The first road anyone walks.  [Sakura Town → Kagura Station · ZU · Easy]

channels.name: route-2
channels.topic: A cart track between hedgerows and barley, telegraph poles all the way.  [Kagura Station → Amber Fields · ZU-PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-3
channels.topic: The land drops to the sea and the track turns to cobbles.  [Amber Fields → Minato Harbour · PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-4
channels.topic: Dunes and scrub to a shingle beach with a wrecked boat on it.  [Kagura Station → the north shore · PU · Dead end]

channels.name: route-5
channels.topic: Orchard, then meadow, then dunes and a long beach.  [Amber Fields → the south beach · PU · Easy]

channels.name: route-6
channels.topic: Ordinary woodland that stops being ordinary about halfway along.  [the lowlands → Ghost Woods · NU · Getting dark]

channels.name: route-7
channels.topic: A ridge path out of the trees, standing stones, heather, towers ahead.  [Ghost Woods → N's Castle · RU · Exposed]

channels.name: route-8
channels.topic: Pine forest rising, with a cold stream and stepping stones across it.  [Ghost Woods → Mt. Silver foothills · RU · Side trail]

channels.name: route-9
channels.topic: Scree, old snow, a ledge trail with a rope line and a long way down.  [N's Castle → the high pass · OU · CLIMB]

channels.name: route-10
channels.topic: Ash flats and lava rock, crossed on a boardwalk that has seen better days.  [Cinder Row → Ember Hollow · RU · Boardwalk]

channels.name: route-11
channels.topic: Basalt terraces like stairs, with the first pylon at the top.  [Ember Hollow → Thunder Shelf · UU · CLIMB]

channels.name: route-12
channels.topic: Black sand, sea stacks, driftwood, ash drifting over everything.  [the north coast → Cinder Row · RU · Easy]

channels.name: route-13
